settings.account.linkedDevicesHint: Move your encryption keys to a new device without losing your conversations.
settings.account.waitingForDeviceHint: On the new device, sign in with this account, then choose "Link with another device" when asked.
settings.account.confirmCodeMatch: Confirm this code matches on both devices

settings.privacy.activityStatusHint: Let friends see what you're playing, watching, or listening to via Rich Presence. Off clears it for everyone but you.
settings.privacy.extensionHint: Adds Rich Presence for YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify, and Twitch — shows up next to game activity, gated by the same toggle above. Browsers block silent extension installs, so this is a two-minute manual step, not a store listing.
settings.privacy.extensionStep1: Click below to reveal the extension folder
settings.privacy.dataCollectedHint: Username and a password hash. Nothing else.
settings.privacy.dmStorageHint: End-to-end encrypted (X3DH + Double Ratchet). The server only ever sees ciphertext.
settings.privacy.channelStorageHint: Message text and file attachments are end-to-end encrypted with a per-channel sender key, shared directly between members — the server only ever sees ciphertext. A member removed from the server can still read messages sent with a key they already received until the channel is next re-keyed.
settings.privacy.ipLoggingHint: None. HollowChat doesn't record your IP address or device info against your account, even for active sessions — a server compromise can't link your account to a network or a device.
